messages:
incidents_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 429 rate observed for GPU hotpath pool 'g-hotpath-us-west'. queue_length=12k, 95p_latency=1.8s, gpu_util=98% — paging oncall (severity: P1). Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-saturation
oncall_ryan: Ack. jumping in. any recent deploys?
eng_sre_julia: No deploys in last 30m. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/g/abc123/hotpath — queue spike correlates with large burst from /v1/generate-tiered-route. tokenbucket refill shows 0 tokens for tier 'standard' for last 3m.
infra_tao: Autoscaler logs show repeated failure to acquire scaling lock: 
```
2026-03-15T09:02:11Z ERROR autoscaler: failed to acquire pool-lock: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z WARN scaling: max_replicas reached for pool g-hotpath-us-west (current=24, max=24)
```
We also see backoff on scaling loops.
ml_infra_eva: Also noticed some routes don't have fallback variants configured (no-cpu fallback). those requests will 429 hard when GPUs saturate.
oncall_ryan: Ok plan: 1) temporarily relax token bucket for 'standard' tier (increase refill rate, raise burst). 2) emergency bump max_replicas for g-hotpath-us-west by +8 if infra can do quick scale. 3) add routing fallback for the busiest route to the cpu-variant until pool recovers. 4) notify support and customers. Who can run tokenbucket change?
eng_sre_julia: I can run it. applying now. command: `internal-configctl set tokenbucket standard --refill=8000 --burst=12000`
eng_sre_julia: applied. tokenbucket metrics now showing refill=8000/s, tokens>0. watch for 429s. :pray:
support_ana: Noted. drafting customer message: "We're aware of elevated errors for generation endpoints in US-WEST. We're applying mitigations and will update in 30 minutes." paste for approval?
oncall_ryan: LGTM. please include rough ETA 30-45m and link to status page.
infra_tao: Bumping pool max_replicas: `infractl pools update g-hotpath-us-west --max 32` -> accepted, provisioning new nodes; warmup ~2-4m.
eng_sre_julia: autoscaler lock errors reduced after tokenbucket change; 429s dropped from 38% -> 12% in 2m. still seeing queue ~6k.
ml_infra_eva: I'm enabling route fallback for /v1/generate-tiered-route: `routes upsert --route /v1/generate-tiered-route --fallback cpu-variant-v2 --priority 90` -> applied. will warm CPU model.
support_ana: Customer ops: ticket #C-9912 from Acme reported 429s at 09:03 and timeout errors. sending update to Acme now.
customer_ops_mark: Acme says their batch job lost ~3% of requests; they want ETA and whether we'll auto-retry. recommending we offer to replay/migrate failed requests where possible.
oncall_ryan: Good catch. engineering will capture failure ids and hand over to support for replay assistance.
eng_sre_julia: Quick note — tokenbucket config had been tuned aggressively in last week's rollout to enforce tight per-tenant limits. that interacted poorly with autoscaler lock/scale limits under sudden surge. filing a followup to revisit default refill/burst.
incidents_bot: Runbook step triggered: create incident channel? /incidents/2401012345 created and linked. Incident commander assigned: oncall_ryan.
oncall_ryan: Current status: 429s down to 6%, queue 2.1k, gpu_util 85%, new GPUs coming up. continuing to monitor. handing off active remediation to @eng_sre_julia for next 12h to ensure tokenbucket & scaling settings stabilize. I will join customer comms and postmortem.
eng_sre_julia: taking over. will keep 10m updates in thread. next steps: revert very-aggressive per-tenant enforcement, add short-term retry window for clients, and schedule postmortem.
infra_tao: new nodes provisioned and joined pool. forced scale applied: pool size=30. infra sanity checks pass.
eng_sre_julia: scaling stabilized; queue draining to ~400. scheduling backfill window to process stuck requests at lower priority.
support_ana: Sent update to impacted customers and status page. replies so far: 2 customers acknowledged, one asked for SLA credit request path.
customer_ops_mark: Logged impacted customers list and forwarded to account teams.
oncall_ryan: Thanks everyone. final notes before handoff: create postmortem ticket, include timeline, tokenbucket mis-tune, autoscaler max_replicas tight limit, missing fallback routing. tag: @product, @security (no data exposure).
eng_sre_julia: created PM ticket: PM-2401. adding logs, grafana snapshots, and commands run.
incidents_bot: Incident resolved to severity P2 at 2401012407. please fill out postmortem template: /templates/incident-postmortem.md
oncall_ryan: Handoff complete to @eng_sre_julia. I'll be on standby for customer escalations. good job team. :thumbsup:
